name: scaffold-deck
body: Scaffold deck: `init [path]` — refuse if `slides/`, `assets/` or `kalide.yaml` already exists; when no path is given also refuse if `templates/` exists, while with a path an existing local `templates/` is exempt (see cli-init-refuse-existing); with no path, write the minimal unbranded seed (deck + local `templates/`) from the scaffold's embedded seed; with a path, validate the external library at `path` fail-fast BEFORE writing anything (templates-dir-validation) AND resolve the deck's theme — optional, default `default` (theme-selection) — against it, so an invalid library or a library that does not resolve the deck's theme aborts with a clear error naming the path, a non-zero exit and nothing written; then write the deck (`slides/`, `assets/`, `kalide.yaml` with `templates: <path>`) and no local `templates/`, leaving any exempt existing local `templates/` untouched and ignored.
